title: Tp Twist
description: TpTwist is a lightweight, configurable plugin that randomly teleports all players.
body:
TpTwist is a lightweight, configurable plugin that randomly teleports all players at regular intervals — adding chaos, fun, and challenge to your survival or mini-game server!

✨ Features
⏱️ Customizable teleport interval (in seconds)

Radius and minimum distance to control teleport spread

Per-world toggle to disable teleporting in specific worlds

⛔ Unsafe block detection (lava, bedrock, non-solid blocks, etc.)...

To configure this plugin usee the config there are 2 commands for Tptwist /tpstart and /tpend

You can add unsafe blocks all blocks compatible 

**Version of Config**
> interval: 300
> display_mode: actionbar # or bossbar
> 
> radius: 10000            # max distance from player's current location
> 
> min_distance: 100        # min distance from player's current location
> 
> countdown: true # false
> 
> disabled_worlds:
>
> world
> 
> world_nether
> 
>   - world_the_end
> 
> unsafe_blocks:
>   - LAVA
>   - WATER
>   - CACTUS
>   - CAMPFIRE
>   - MAGMA_BLOCK

## Notes
- I recommend Action bar mode not default
- if you want this updated for earlier version suggest it on my discord or if you want a update but i will probably update it but not as a priority
